description: As a nurse practitioner and healthcare provider, I have watched healthcare become increasingly difficult for patients to navigate. And the frustration people feel is growing. Patients wait months for appointments. Primary care access is limited in many areas. Emergency departments are overcrowded. Healthcare workers are burned out.
